sections.content_markdown:
1. The angle inscribed in a major arc is-
1) acute angle 2) obtuse angle
3) right angle 4) complementary angle

2. What is the value of the angle $x$ in the circle with centre $O$?
1) $126^\circ$ 2) $108^\circ$
3) $72^\circ$ 4) $54^\circ$

3. In the adjacent figure $\frac{1}{2} \angle ECD =$ how much degrees?
1) $40^\circ$ 2) $50^\circ$
3) $80^\circ$ 4) $100^\circ$

4. Two circles intersects each other externally. If one of their diametes is $8 \text{ cm}$ and the radius of the another is $4 \text{ cm}$, what is the distance between their two centres?
1) 0 2) 4 3) 8 4) 12

5. If two tangents $PQ$ and $PR$ are drawn from the external point $P$ in a circle with centre $O$, then $\triangle PQR$ will be-
(i) isosceles
(ii) equilateral
(iii) right angled
Which one the following is correct?
1) $i$ 2) $i$ and $ii$ 3) $ii$ and $iii$ 4) $i, ii$ and $iii$

6. If $O$ is the circumcentre of the equilateral triangle $ABC$, then $\angle BOC =$ how much degrees?
1) $30^\circ$ 2) $60^\circ$ 3) $90^\circ$ 4) $120^\circ$
